tips.text: Aim Lay Waste at a single target when you can; it hits much harder on one enemy than on a group. Use it on lone camps and lone champions.
Toggle Defile on when you are standing in a camp or next to an enemy, and switch it off when nothing is near. It drains your mana quickly.
Put Wall of Pain in a chasing enemy's path so they are slowed and take more magic damage. It also works to stop an escape.
Use Requiem from level 6 to finish low-health enemies anywhere on the map. Check the map for kills in other lanes before you start the channel.
Enemies see Requiem coming and can stop it. Flash or a kill on you interrupts the channel, so start it when you are safe.
When you die, keep casting with Death Defied. Stand where enemies must pass and use Lay Waste and Defile; Requiem stops working partway through.
Kill camps and units with Defile on to get mana back. Destroying a structure with it also restores mana.
Aim Lay Waste at a single enemy when you can; it hits much harder when it catches only one target, so use it on the enemy, not on a group of minions.
Lay Waste has a short delay before it lands, so aim where the enemy is walking, not where they stand.
Place Wall of Pain in the path of an enemy who is running at you or fleeing; they are slowed and lose Magic Resist after touching it.
Turn on Defile only when enemies are close enough to hit, and turn it off when they leave, because it drains your mana quickly.
Killing minions or structures with Defile gives mana back, which helps you keep your spells going.
If you die, keep casting with Death Defied while you can; your spells cost nothing, but you can't move. Hit anything that walks near your body.
Use Requiem from level 6 to finish enemies hurt anywhere on the map; the damage reaches them at any distance. Ask allies to call out low-health targets.
Start Requiem only when you are safe, because enemies see a beam of light and Flash or death interrupts it.
Cast Requiem when Graves is low after a jungle fight or a gank; he cannot easily dodge it from across the map.
Put Wall of Pain in the narrow path Graves needs to chase you through. It slows him and lowers his Magic Resist.
Graves dashes with Quickdraw to close in, so don't stand still with Defile on. Slow him first, then keep your distance.
If Graves kills you, keep casting with Death Defied. Lay Waste and Wall of Pain can still punish him if he stays near your body.
Aim Lay Waste so it hits Graves alone. A lone target takes much more damage than a group.
Keep Wall of Pain ready for when Jarvan IV dives in; it slows him and cuts his Magic Resist, so Lay Waste and Defile hit harder.
Stay away from the line between Jarvan IV and his Demacian Standard. If he pulls himself along it, you get knocked up and can't escape.
Hit Jarvan IV with Lay Waste when he is alone. A single target takes much more damage from it.
If Jarvan IV kills you, keep casting Lay Waste and Defile from your spirit form. He can't hit you there, so use it to finish him.
Don't toggle Defile on while Jarvan IV is hunting you. It drains your mana fast, and you need that mana for Lay Waste and Wall of Pain.
Hit Kayn with Wall of Pain when he runs at you; it slows him and lowers his Magic Resist, so Lay Waste and Defile hurt more.
Aim Lay Waste so it hits Kayn alone; a single target takes much more damage.
Do not stand still once Kayn has damaged you. Umbral Trespass can reach a marked target, so keep your health up.
Kayn can slip through walls with Shadow Step. Watch the edge of nearby terrain for his warning and don't sit with your back to a wall.
Keep casting after you die. Death Defied lets you keep using Lay Waste and Defile, so keep Kayn inside the area.
Stay near your minions, turret or allies. Kha'Zix hits much harder with Taste Their Fear when you are isolated.
Put Wall of Pain where Kha'Zix will jump in or run out. He is slowed and loses Magic Resist, so your damage hits harder.
Keep Defile on when Kha'Zix lands on you. It deals steady damage to him and he can't easily avoid it.
Use Requiem to finish him when he is low. It hits from any distance, even after he escapes.
Hit him with Lay Waste when he is alone, since it deals extra damage when it hits only one enemy.
If you die, keep casting Lay Waste and Defile from Death Defied. Kha'Zix may stay close to finish the fight.
Hit Kindred with Lay Waste alone when you can; a lone target takes double damage, so avoid hitting her next to minions or monsters.
Put Wall of Pain in her path when she dashes or chases; she is slowed and loses Magic Resist.
Kindred is fragile, so pressure her with Lay Waste from range and force her to play cautiously.
Do not count on Requiem to finish her if she has Lamb's Respite up; it stops units from dying inside the zone.
If you die near her, keep casting during Death Defied, but stay out of her reach; Defile still hurts anyone who stays close.
Put Wall of Pain in front of Lee Sin when he closes in; the slow and the lost Magic Resist make him easy to hit with Lay Waste.
Stay away from his allies and the walls around you; Dragon's Rage can kick him into you, so keep your team spread out.
Lee Sin takes magic damage badly, so Lay Waste hits him hard when it lands on him alone.
Keep Defile off until he is close, then turn it on; it hurts him while he chases you and drains your mana fast.
If Lee Sin kills you, keep casting Lay Waste and Defile from your spirit form; he can't touch you while it lasts.
Lay Waste does double damage on a lone target, so aim it at Master Yi when he is alone, such as when he is farming camps.
Master Yi can't be slowed once Highlander is active, so save Wall of Pain for before he turns it on.
Stay near minions or allies so Alpha Strike has other targets, and keep Defile running when he jumps on you.
Use Requiem when Master Yi is low after a fight. Meditate heals him, so finish him before he channels it.
Use Wall of Pain on the path Naafiri dashes through; she ends up slowed and takes more magic damage from you.
Aim Lay Waste at Naafiri herself, not her packmates. It hits much harder when it catches only one enemy.
Keep your health high when Naafiri is around. Requiem does not stop her from diving, so do not count on it to save you.
If you die near her, keep casting from your spirit form. Lay Waste and Defile still hit her if she stays close.
Hold your Wall of Pain for when Nocturne dives in; it slows him and cuts his Magic Resist, so your damage hurts more.
Stay away from Nocturne when Unspeakable Horror is ready; if the tether holds, he fears you and you cannot fight back well.
Keep moving away when Nocturne's Shroud of Darkness is up, since it blocks your next ability. Bait it with a cheap Lay Waste first.
Nocturne can dash to you from across the map with Paranoia. Stay near allies and keep your Wall of Pain ready when the map goes dark.
Even if you die to Nocturne, keep casting Lay Waste and Defile from your spirit form, and stay out of the fight if you can't hit him.
Keep your distance from Shyvana and poke with Lay Waste; she is weak when she cannot hit you.
Put Wall of Pain in her path when she runs at you; she is slowed and loses Magic Resist.
Aim Lay Waste at her alone so it hits for double damage, and keep her away from her minions.
Do not stand on her dragon form flight path; Dragon's Descent makes you flee and she then closes the gap. Walk away from her landing spot.
Keep Defile off when she is far away; it costs a lot of mana and only hurts enemies close to you.
Use Requiem to finish her if she is low after a fight; it hits from any distance.
Put Wall of Pain down on the path Skarner charges along; he is immune to slows during Ixtal's Impact, but the wall still cuts his Magic Resist.
Stay far from Skarner and poke with Lay Waste; he has to get close to do his damage.
Keep your distance from walls when Skarner charges; if he drags you into one, you are stunned.
If you die, keep casting Lay Waste and Defile from your spirit form on enemies who stay close to your corpse.
Use Requiem to finish Skarner once he is hurt from a fight, because he cannot dodge it or run out of its range.
Cast Requiem when Sylas is low on health. He can heal with Kingslayer, so finish him before he gets the chance.
Keep Wall of Pain in front of you when Sylas closes in. He ends up slowed and takes more magic damage.
Aim Lay Waste at Sylas when he is alone. A blast that hits only one enemy deals double damage.
Stay away from where Sylas can dash in. Abduct stuns and knocks you up, and he reaches you fast.
If you die, keep casting Lay Waste and Defile with Death Defied. Sylas will often walk in to finish you.
Keep Wall of Pain ready for when Talon jumps in; it slows him and makes your follow-up damage hurt more.
Stay away from walls Talon can vault over and watch for his Shadow Assault, since he can appear next to you quickly.
Keep Defile on when Talon dives you; it hits him every second while he is next to you, and you cannot be pushed around.
If Talon kills you, keep casting Lay Waste and Defile from your spirit form, and use Requiem early enough to finish before it ends.
Use Requiem when Talon is low after a fight; it hits from any distance, and he cannot hide from it by vaulting walls.
Keep Lay Waste on Viego when he is alone; it hits much harder against a single target. Use it to poke him when he's isolated.
Put Wall of Pain where Viego must run through it; he is slowed and loses Magic Resist, so he can't easily close in on you.
Use Requiem from far away when Viego is low after a fight; it hits him wherever he is.
If Viego kills you, keep casting while you are in spirit form. He can't hit you, so Defile and Lay Waste still punish him.
Don't let Viego reach you in a fight when you can't move. Spectral Maw stuns the first enemy it hits, so stay out of its line.
Place Wall of Pain in front of Xin Zhao when he charges. It slows him and cuts his Magic Resist.
Keep Lay Waste on Xin Zhao as he approaches, but stay away from him. Audacious Charge closes the gap fast.
Do not stand where Xin Zhao can finish his third Three Talon Strike attack. The knock up sets up his whole combo.
If you die, keep casting Lay Waste and Defile from your spirit form on whoever stands near you.
Use Requiem when Xin Zhao is low after a fight or camp. Damage that hits from far away is hard for him to avoid.
Use Lay Waste on Ashe whenever she is alone in the blast; the damage is much higher.
Put Wall of Pain behind Ashe when you trade; she will be slowed and take more magic damage.
Stay out of a straight line with Ashe so Enchanted Crystal Arrow is hard to land on you. A stun from far away means death.
Stay behind your minions so Volley arrows are absorbed before they reach you.
Ashe has few ways to escape, so Requiem can finish her when she is low.
Poke with Lay Waste on Caitlyn when she is alone in the lane; it hits much harder when it catches only one enemy.
Keep out of Piltover Peacemaker's long range, because it hits from far away and Karthus has little to dodge it with.
Put Wall of Pain on the lane when you want to fight; enemies who cross it are slowed and lose Magic Resist.
Watch for Yordle Snap Trap before you step forward with Defile; being rooted next to her is deadly.
If you die, keep casting Lay Waste and Defile from Death Defied at anyone who walks over your body.
Use Requiem at level 6 when Caitlyn is hurt from lane; it hits her from anywhere on the map.
Use Lay Waste on Ezreal when he is alone in range, because it hits much harder against one target. Aim it where he walks to last-hit.
Put Wall of Pain across the path Ezreal needs to take to get at you. He is slowed and loses Magic Resist, so your next spells hurt more.
Ezreal can dodge Lay Waste, so aim it where he is walking. It lands after a short delay.
Ezreal can blink away with Arcane Shift, so don't expect to finish him just by stepping on him with Defile. Turn Defile on only when he is close.
If you die, keep casting with Death Defied while Ezreal is near your corpse. Lay Waste still goes off, so use it.
Use Requiem when Ezreal is low from a trade or has gone to base. Telegraphed beams warn him, so he may flee.
Aim Lay Waste at Jhin when he is alone in the area; a blast that hits only one enemy hurts far more.
Place Wall of Pain where Jhin must walk to reach you or his minions; he is slowed and takes extra magic damage.
Step out of line when Jhin aims Deadly Flourish, especially right after you were hit by his ally, because it roots.
Watch the ground for Jhin's hidden traps before walking forward to harass him.
Keep your health high once you reach level 6, since Requiem hits Jhin from anywhere and finishes him when he is weak.
If you die in lane, keep casting with Death Defied and keep Defile on if enemies stand near your corpse.
Poke Jinx with Lay Waste when she is alone in the blast; it hits much harder on a single target than on a crowd.
Place Wall of Pain where Jinx will walk or flee; she is slowed and loses Magic Resist, so follow up with Lay Waste.
Turn on Defile only when Jinx or her support is close enough to be hit; it drains your mana fast.
Jinx is easy to finish with Requiem after a trade, because it hits her from any distance. Her low health makes her a good target.
If you die, keep casting Lay Waste and Defile in your Death Defied form; you can't move, so aim at where enemies are standing.
Poke with Lay Waste on a lone target; it hits much harder when it catches only one enemy, so aim at Kai'Sa when her support stands apart.
Lay Waste outranges Kai'Sa's basic attacks. Poke her when she walks up to last-hit minions.
Put Wall of Pain across her path when she tries to close in; she is slowed and takes more magic damage.
Turn on Defile when she is close and stuck in a fight. Turn it off when she leaves, because it drains your mana fast.
Keep casting after you die. Death Defied lets you land Lay Waste and Defile while the enemy is chasing you.
Use Requiem to finish Kai'Sa when she is low. She can't escape it by running, but she can interrupt it with a Flash.
Poke Miss Fortune with Lay Waste when she steps up to last-hit; it deals double damage when it hits only her.
Put Wall of Pain across her path when she dashes in or retreats; she is slowed and her Strut speed will not save her.
Hitting her breaks Strut's speed bonus, so land a Lay Waste before she can close in or run away.
Respect Double Up through minions; stand away from the minion in front of you so the shot cannot bounce to you.
Do not stand still in Make It Rain or in front of Bullet Time; both hurt a lot if you stay in them. Move sideways out of them.
Use Requiem when she is low after a fight; it hits her from anywhere on the map.
Use Lay Waste on Sivir when she is alone, so it hits for much more. Cast it where she will walk, since it lands after a short delay.
Bait Spell Shield with a weak Lay Waste before you cast Wall of Pain or Requiem. She can only block one ability.
Dodge Boomerang Blade. If it hits you on the way out, stay out of its path on the way back.
Keep farming with Lay Waste and stay out of Sivir's reach. She pushes fast, so do not let the wave crash into your tower.
If you die, keep casting Lay Waste and Defile from your spirit form on anyone close to you.
Poke with Lay Waste on Smolder whenever he walks up to last-hit; it hits much harder when he is the only enemy it touches.
Fight Smolder early, before his Dragon Practice stacks have made his abilities hit hard.
Place Wall of Pain where Smolder must cross to reach you, so he is slowed and takes more magic damage.
Turn on Defile when Smolder flies in with Flap, Flap, Flap, but stay out of his Achooo! line.
Use Requiem to finish Smolder when he retreats low on health; it reaches him from any distance.
Poke Yunara with Lay Waste when she is alone in the blast; a lone target takes much more damage.
Place Wall of Pain where Yunara must walk to reach you or her minions; she is slowed and takes more magic damage.
Turn on Defile when Yunara walks up to trade; it hurts everyone close to you, but it drains your mana fast.
Keep casting after you die. Death Defied lets you drop a last Lay Waste or Defile on anyone who chases your corpse.
Use Requiem to finish Yunara when she is hurt after a trade, since it hits wherever she is.
